overview: Cursor (parent entity: Anysphere, San Francisco) is an AI-native, VS Code-derived code editor, founded 2022 by four MIT students (Michael Truell, Sualeh Asif, Arvid Lunnemark, Aman Sanger). Separately, Cursor drew a Composer 2 model-provenance controversy in March 2026 (marketed as proprietary, revealed to be built on a third-party Chinese open-weight model) that cost it at least one named enterprise customer (Notion).

full_event_log.Event Title: Cursor Router launched across all Cursor surfaces

full_event_log.Description: Cursor launched Cursor Router, an automatic model-selection layer for Teams and Enterprise plans. The system classifies each coding request and routes it to the cheapest model capable of handling it, enabling cost savings.
full_event_log.Event Title: Cursor Router Launch

full_event_log.Description: Cursor launched and expanded a CFO Council aimed at turning CFOs into central players in AI strategy rather than peripheral observers. The council is focused on building a playbook for measuring and maximizing AI ROI and agentic productivity returns. This initiative reflects a broader push to quantify the business value of AI adoption.
full_event_log.Event Title: Cursor expands CFO Council to drive AI ROI strategy

full_event_log.Description: Defense tech company Anduril is reportedly in talks to raise a new round of capital at a valuation of approximately $100 billion, according to Reuters citing anonymous sources. This would represent an increase of roughly $40 billion from its previous valuation, more than tripling its mark from the prior year.
full_event_log.Event Title: Anduril in talks to raise funding at $100B valuation, up ~$40B from prior mark

full_event_log.Description: Cursor announced localized pricing for India, its third-largest market globally, signaling a major push into the region. The company also plans to expand local hiring and enterprise sales in India. This move comes ahead of a reported SpaceX acquisition.
full_event_log.Event Title: Cursor launches localized pricing in India as country becomes third-largest market
Q402 installs into Cursor

full_event_log.Description: Cursor introduced monthly billing with auto-renewal starting July 28, 2026. The update provides generous access to Cursor models including Grok 4.5 and Composer with sufficient usage for daily agent development.
full_event_log.Event Title: Monthly billing with auto-renewal launch

full_event_log.Description: Kimi K3 was officially released on July 28, 2026. The company noted a 4-point reduction in the performance gap between open-source and closed-source models on key benchmarks. Users praised the seamless experience.
full_event_log.Event Title: Kimi K3 launched on Cursor

full_event_log.Description: SailPoint and Cursor partnered to create agent security options for enterprises. The new Cursor Enterprise connector enables organizations to securely leverage Cursor's agentic software development capabilities without compromising security.
full_event_log.Event Title: SailPoint introduces new Cursor Enterprise connector for AI-driven software development

full_event_log.Description: Flapping Airplanes, a research-focused AI startup working on data-efficient model training, is in talks to raise capital at a $5 billion valuation. The information was reported by Forbes citing multiple sources familiar with the deal.
full_event_log.Event Title: Flapping Airplanes in talks to raise funding at $5 billion valuation

full_event_log.Description: SpaceX stock up 4% as a $60 billion acquisition deal involving Cursor nears completion. The deal is expected to close in August 2026.
full_event_log.Event Title: $60B Cursor Deal Nears Close

full_event_log.Description: Cursor Research open-sourced the kernel underlying its Composer agentic coding model on August 4, 2026. The release revealed that mixture-of-experts communication, rather than compute, was the primary bottleneck in the system.
full_event_log.Event Title: Cursor open-sources MoE Megakernel powering Composer agentic coding model

full_event_log.Description: Cursor agents now have the ability to write to Gmail, Google Drive, and Google Calendar, expanding their integration capabilities with Google Workspace applications.
full_event_log.Event Title: Cursor agents gain write access to Gmail, Drive, and Calendar
AI agent faked identities to target real people

full_event_log.Description: Cursor hit $2 billion ARR in 2026 while GitHub Copilot's market share among developers fell from 67% to 51%. Claude Code emerged as the most-loved coding tool among engineers during this period.
full_event_log.Event Title: Cursor reaches $2B ARR, GitHub Copilot market share falls to 51%

full_event_log.Description: SpaceX expects to reach $100 billion in annualized revenue run rate by the end of 2026, with contributions from Cursor. This projection is based on expected revenue in December 2026.
full_event_log.Event Title: Cursor contributing to $100 billion ARR trajectory by end of 2026

full_event_log.Description: Space Exploration Technologies projects reaching $100 billion in annualized revenue run rate by the end of FY2026, with contribution from Cursor. This projection is based on expected revenue in December of that year.
full_event_log.Event Title: Cursor contribution to $100 billion ARR milestone

full_event_log.Description: Cursor AI-powered code editor achieved $500 million in annual recurring revenue by 2026. The platform offers unlimited AI features at $16 per month and rebuilt VS Code from scratch.
full_event_log.Event Title: Cursor reaches $500 million ARR milestone
